boundary: Measured engineering increments only. Tests and automated review do not establish customer acceptance, legal compliance or whole-product readiness.

increments.title: Purpose-bound inquiry admission
increments.change: Released bounded request handling, explicit purpose and notice-version gates, default-off admission and literal inquiry records.
increments.limitations: Receiver health and source release verified. Intake enablement, provider-copy handling, retention and accountable operator acceptance remain separate.

increments.title: Offline privacy-action review packets
increments.change: Implemented strict metadata review packets, explicit identity, policy, hold and copy gates, malformed-input containment and exact record-version binding.
increments.limitations: Validated on synthetic input; not merged or deployed. No provider access, deletion, verified identity or execution authority.
